title: Brioche French Toast
subtitle: Thick-cut Texas brioche · 325°F griddle
headnote: Custardy, golden French toast made with thick Texas brioche. Makes 6 slices.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt until fully combined.
Dip each brioche slice in the custard for 15–20 seconds per side, allowing it to soak without falling apart.
Melt a little butter on the griddle. Cook the soaked brioche for 3–4 minutes per side, until deep golden brown and cooked through.
sourceNote: From French Toast Chat, September 26, 2026. Retains the specified 325°F griddle setting.
